newsitem.title: USA: China won't take TCK wheat, US sees trade barrier.
newsitem.headline: China won't take TCK wheat, US sees trade barrier.

text.p: China will not accept wheat from any source if it is tainted by TCK smut, Trade Minister Wu Yi said Friday and argued that, despite U.S. doubts, the rule was not a ban on U.S. wheat sales.
"Canada imports TCK wheat from Canada but not from the United States," Commerce Secretary Mickey Kantor said in a strongly worded exchange with Wu at a news conference.
Wu offered to quit her job if anyone could prove China did not apply its prohibition evenhandedly.
U.S. officials say the ban is unfair.
"We do not approve the import of TCK wheat," Wu said. "I can tell you explicitly, China has never imported any TCK wheat from Canada."
She said China inadvertently bought one million tonnes of TCK wheat this year -- "maybe because we were taken in.
"TCK wheat can cause disastrous effects on our agriculture," she said in defense of China's policy.
Wu said she told Kantor during a face-to-face session earlier in the day that U.S. and Chinese agricultural officials should consult on the issue.

U.S. officials say the Chinese policy effectively has cut off wheat sales to China. They contend TCK smut, a fungus, poses no threat to China because imported wheat would be milled and consumed in cities, not in the grain regions.
"We will continue to discuss this," Kantor said.
Wu denied there was a cut-off of U.S. trade. "Vast areas" of U.S. wheat territory is free of TCK smut, she said. "China has never banned imports of U.S. wheat," she said.
The Pacific Northwest is the region where TCK smut is prevelant.
More than one million tonnes of U.S. wheat sales to China were cancelled this summer as the TCK disupte flared.

U.S. Agriculture Undersecretary Gene Moos has said high-ranking officials might have to step in to settle the dispute. Otherwise, the United States would lose access to the No. 1 wheat importer in the world and China would lock itself out of one of the world's leading wheat growers.
